title: `teploy cloud server delete --yes --json` (rev 22, cloud-v1): the deleted server and whether its servers.yml entry was removed (only when its host was the server's address). Failures use the error envelope on stderr and never emit this shape.

status.description: Teploy Cloud's server status (active, provisioning, inactive, error, rebooting, suspended). A consumer must treat an unknown value as not ready.

ip_address.description: The server's IPv4; empty until the provider assigns one (Teploy Cloud's 0.0.0.0 placeholder is reported as empty, never as an address).
